     Morning Glory. Convolvulaceæ.

     Fragmentary provings by Jeanes from tincture of leaves, 2d dil., in 1843 (marked l.), and from preparing tincture of seed in 1845 (marked s.).

CLINICAL AUTHORITIES.

- Renal calculus, Farrington, A. H. Z., vol. 101, p. 134.

   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Ipom.]
Vertiginous affection, immediately ; s.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Ipom.]
Pain first in right then in left temple ; s.
Pain in right temple and eye ; l.
Pain in left Pain in left temple, jaw and eye ; l.
Great heaviness of head ; s.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Ipom.]
Itching of scalp ; s.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Ipom.]
Smarting of eyes ; s.
Itching of internal canthus of left eye ; l.
Pain in right eye and temple ; l.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Ipom.]
Very acute sense of smell ; s.
Smarting and dryness in nostrils ; s.
Purulent discharge from nose ; s.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Ipom.]
Pain in left upper jaw, eye and temple ; l.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Ipom.]
Pain in left tonsil ; l.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Ipom.]
Rumbling and grumbling in epigastric region ; l.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Ipom.]
Sharp cutting pain in abdomen above umbilicus ; l.
Rumbling of flatus : with pain in left superior flexure of colon, followed by speedy discharge of flatus ; in transverse colon ; in region of sigmoid flexure ; s.
Pain in region of descending colon ; l.
Shooting reports of flatus in abdomen ; s.
Grumbling in lower bowels ; l.
Great distension of abdomen ; l.
Flashing heat in superior abdomen and stomach ; l.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Ipom.]
Severe pains in left kidney, with paroxysms of pain running along ureter and in back ; nausea and occasional vomiting. θ Renal calculus.
Diminution of contractile power of bladder ; l.
Kidney disorders or gravel with pain in back.
   

COUGH. [27] [Ipom.]
Disposition to cough ; sneezing ; l.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Ipom.]
Pain in first dorsal vertebræ ; l.
Itching over left scapula ; s.
Pain in lumbar region ; l.
Pain in left lumbar region ; l.
Pain in region of lumbar vertebræ ; l.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Ipom.]
Aching in top of right shoulder ; s.
Pain in right biceps flexor cubiti near elbow ; s.
Pain in left shoulder and arm ; s.
   

FEVER. [40] [Ipom.]
Backache alternating with chilliness ; l.
Flushing of heat followed by copious sweats.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Ipom.]
Right : pain in temple ; in eye ; aching in top of shoulder ; pain in biceps flexor cubiti near elbow.
Left : pain in temple, jaw and eye ; itching of internal canthus of eye ; pain in upper jaw ; pain in tonsil ; pain in superior flexure of colon ; severe pain in kidney ; itching over scapula ; pain in lumbar region ; pain in shoulder and arm.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Ipom.]
Pain in right then in left temple ; in eye ; in jaw ; in r. eye and temple ; in left upper jaw, eye and temple ; in l. tonsil ; in left superior flexure of colon ; in region of descending colon ; along ureter and back ; in first dorsal vertebræ ; in lumbar region ; in left lumbar region ; in region of lumbar vertebræ ; in right biceps flexor cubiti near elbow ; in left shoulder and arm.
Severe pain : in left kidney.
Sharp cutting pain : in abdomen above umbilicus.
Aching : in top of right shoulder.
Backache : alternating with chilliness.
Smarting : of eyes ; in nostrils.
Dryness : in nostrils.
Heaviness : of head.
Great distension of abdomen.
Flushing heat : in superior abdomen and stomach.
Itching : of scalp ; of internal canthus of left eye ; over left scapula.
